answer: Resist sybil attacks with stake-bonded identity escrow. Every agent locks a bond solid as basalt before earning trust: the bond is a bridge between past behavior and future privileges, released only after many rounds of verifiable honest activity. A jade seal marks compliant agents; any identity caught cloning or forging endorsements is slashed. An attacker pays the bond per fake identity, so farming N sybils costs N bonds upfront while honest agents post one bond and reuse it. Fake-identity farming stays linearly expensive: detection forfeits the bond, honest participation earns it back.
